capabilities.description: Interact with legitimate public or authorized web experiences, including navigation, clicks, typing, form submission, and multi-step flows within policy.
Read messages in an authorized mailbox or research inbox, including legitimately received follow-up.
Read public comments/replies from an authorized public surface.
Read items from an RSS/Atom or equivalent subscribed feed.
Observe public creator content and basic public performance/context signals.
Capture an allowed visual snapshot of a public webpage or public content item.
Acquire permitted public or authorized video/audio media and associated metadata without bypassing access controls.
Acquire available public or authorized captions/transcripts for evidence use while preserving source and modality limits.
Inspect deterministic media/container/stream metadata without treating metadata as semantic visual/audio understanding.
Perform deterministic local video mechanics such as clipping, transcoding, scaling, muxing, or format conversion.
Extract or convert authorized audio from local/authorized media for downstream inspection or production.
Extract representative frames or bounded visual samples from authorized video for downstream inspection.
Create, inspect, update, pause, or disable an authorized host/OS/workflow schedule; schedule mechanics do not themselves execute or prove completion of AURA work.
Generate an avatar-presented video from approved script, voice, and visual inputs.
Schedule an approved social content Asset for future publication.
Query governed first-party business data through a provider-neutral semantic or equivalent analytical interface.
Retrieve the definitions, plan, evidence, coverage, freshness, lineage, and reason codes behind a governed business-data result.
Create or retrieve an authorized portable dataset/export derived from governed business data without mutating canonical truth.
Create an authorized derived business-data artifact such as a saved result, chart/table dataset, or reproducible analysis snapshot.
Submit an already-formed business action into a governed proposal lifecycle without granting execution authority.
Preview an eligible governed business action, exclusions, constraints, side effects, and approval requirements before execution.
Execute a supported, separately authorized governed business action and return execution status/receipt evidence.
Read an authoritative action/external-execution receipt used to record and verify a BusinessOS ChangeEvent.
Read governed business measurement, outcome, experiment, incrementality, attribution, or related evaluation evidence when available.
Use a governed measurement/evaluation surface to compare an intervention with outcomes while preserving evidence and causal limits.
Receive or subscribe to authorized business occurrence/event signals for reactive or continuous operation; an event is evidence, not authorization to act.
Read an authorized governed event catalog/ontology so BusinessOS can understand available event meanings without hardcoding provider event names.
Read producer/consumer/event coverage and readiness metadata for a governed event plane.
Read current event-plane operational/readiness state, rollout mode, and degradation information.
Inspect, create, reconcile, enable, disable, or update an authorized governed event subscription/managed binding without bypassing provider policy.
Dry-run or preview event-to-consumer evaluation without performing an external/customer-visible effect.
Read an authorized event trace linking occurrence, policy, delivery, evaluation, action, exposure, outcome, and reason-coded failures.
Read event-plane reconciliation/repair state for missing mappings, delivery gaps, receipt gaps, conflicts, or other reason-coded degradation.
Preview a governed replay/re-evaluation plan without performing effects.
Host/harness ability to receive or reliably surface an authorized provider event delivery for a BusinessOS run; this is execution machinery, not event truth.
